_comment: THE DEVICE GATE'S PRECONDITIONS, in machine-readable form.
STANDING ORDER (Rafe, 2026-09-03): no build installs to the phone unless, ON THAT EXACT
BUILD, all four hold. Rafe's walk is the LAST gate, not the first working one.
This file is the declared state and tools/tier0_harness/gate_precheck.py is the enforcement.
build_review_app.sh calls it and REFUSES TO INSTALL if it fails. A rule that depends on my
restraint is not a rule — this session has proved that twice — so the rule lives in the
build path rather than in an intention.
A build announcement missing any of the four is itself a defect, so the precheck prints them
and the announcement quotes its output.
_approved_capture_note: ⚠ BLOCKING, AND THE GAP IS REAL RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT OF THIS ROUND.
Condition 3 needs 'the last Rafe-approved capture of the same surface'. THE RECORD DOES NOT
CONTAIN ONE. No floor capture in this session has been approved outright: the verdicts run
'not wowed, impressed, close', 'closer, legitimately impressed, one axis remains', 'passed
in kind', and a run of FAILs. Each praised something and culled something.
Picking one myself would be choosing the baseline my own work is judged against, which is
exactly the conflict the comparative seat exists to remove. So it stays null and the gate
stays shut until Rafe names it.

ruled_fixes.rule: wear modulates the same stones; it never replaces their identity. The lane must read as the SAME masonry, polished — on-lane identity and lane-vs-flank both at or above §13.8's perceptual floor, MEASURED ON THE BUILD.
ruled_fixes._ruled: RULED (Rafe, 2026-09-08): 'Re-express the POLISH_LANE_GAIN pin as the law it stood for: the precheck asserts the window — on-lane identity >= perceptual floor AND lane-vs-flank >= floor — measured on the build; 0.3 ratified as the current value meeting it, with the polish_by_age floor recorded as the lower bound's reason. Assertions derive, never copy.'
ruled_fixes._current_value: POLISH_LANE_GAIN = 0.3, RATIFIED 2026-09-08 as the current value meeting the window: on-lane 0.1602 (1.11x the floor) and lane-vs-flank 0.3732 (2.59x). It replaces 0.6, which by then read on-lane 0.1338 — BELOW the floor — because the window moved when #174 corrected the lamp and Ruling 56 was re-ratified (§6.2's re-derivation rule).
ruled_fixes._lower_bound_reason: THE polish_by_age FLOOR. The mask is max(polish_by_age, LanePolish) and polish_by_age reaches 0.45, so below about 0.3 the age layer takes over and the lane gain stops biting: 0.6->0.3 buys 5.4 points of the specular's share (28.8% -> 23.4% at the standing case, shoulder nulled) while 0.3->0.2 buys 1.3 and costs 0.03 of lane-vs-flank. 0.3 sits at that knee. This is the REASON for the lower bound, recorded per the ruling — it is not itself an assertion, because the assertion is the window.
ruled_fixes._superseded: was const:POLISH_LANE_GAIN==0.6 — a copied value that went on asserting after its premises moved. Bible §13.12.

exception.ruled: RULED (Rafe, 2026-10-16): 'One-build exception for the lane-window-held check on the R1 build (c8932ed3). The worn path crossing the hot tiles between lamp and fire is #184's problem and was exposed, not caused, by the Λ rerouting traffic through the new bay. The walk doesn't depend on the floor. This exception covers this build and no other; #184 owns the fix and the check runs un-excepted from the next build on. Record on #184 that a blocked corridor reroutes wear onto the brightest tiles; that's the case the fix has to handle.'
exception._binding: The frame is c8932ed3's combined.png, byte-identical (on-lane 0.1051). The build id is c8932ed3's tree plus only the R1b-r005-GATE-STOP.md note and the precheck's exception code (185462fd) — no pixel input moved. Both must match or the exception lapses on its own; from the next build the check binds un-excepted.

ruled_fixes.rule: the travel axis is per pixel, never per tile
the per-tile channel flag does not apply under a route
a joint level with its stone takes the polish
the face/joint delivered specular ratio is capped
the lane's shoulder frays; nothing is staged
the sheltered joint draws its depth from a distribution
